#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long solve(long long a, long long b) {
    long long x1 = min(a, b);
    long long x2 = max(a, b);
    if (x1 == 1) {
        long long memo[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1};
        return x1 * x2 - memo[x2 % 6];
    }
    if (x1 == 2) {
        if (x2 == 2) return 0;
        if (x2 == 3 || x2 == 7) return x1 * x2 - 2;
        return x1 * x2;
    }
    long long product = x1 * x2;
    return (product & 1) == 0 ? product : product - 1;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cout << solve(n, m) << endl;
    return 0;
}
